module.purpose: Provides a module-level WeakMap cache for asynchronously loading and storing React hook names per inspected element, with timeout, suspense-thenable support, and performance logging.
module.summary: This module implements a persistent cache that maps React DevTools Element objects to thenables resolving to HookNames. It supports both React's use() suspense API and manual status inspection for environments without it. Loading is initiated lazily; a pending thenable with callback sets is stored in the cache, and success/error/timeout paths mutate its status. A 30-second timeout guards against hangs. The cache is intentionally module-level so it survives inspected-element cache refreshes. Debug logging is gated behind the __DEBUG__ constant, and all load completions are reported via a logging callback.
module.businessContext: Part of React DevTools Shared. Caches hook names for inspected components. Failure causes missing hook names in the Components panel and confusing debugging.
functions: readRecord (~L30-49): Reads a thenable via React.use or status checks, returning value or null.
hasAlreadyLoadedHookNames (~L62-65): Reports whether hook names are already fulfilled for an element.
